notes.title: Bug Fixing Update
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! We are happy to announce we've fixed a couple of issues in the game! You many now enjoy the experience as intended. The fixed issues were as follows:

Metzgerei and Tiergarten freezing on restart.

Metzgerei and Tiergarten not registering as complete.

Lack of Congratulations image after completing a level:https://steamcommunity.com/app/2736480/discussions/0/4353373056332280259/

When the completing Tiergarten, the completed icon appears on a locked Underground level.

Achievements not registering on hidden kittens levels(Mac):https://steamcommunity.com/app/2736480/discussions/0/6171701201027368880/

We hope you continue to enjoy the game! Let us know if things now work on your end!

notes.title: GENERAL UPDATE(MAC AND WINDOWS)
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! We have fixed the achievements issue on Mac, alongside some minor bugs on Windows(Congratulations screen not showing up in Hauptbahnhof bonus and the advanced mode not being registered as complete), you may now enjoy the game with these issues fixed!
